class.name: GoreComponent
class.brief_description: Dismemberment with configurable blood painting, particles and pools.
class.description: The three effect toggles control automatic cut hooks. Direct effect calls can also be used independently. The default paint mask uses vertex blue; preserve that channel for the effect. A standard Godot material can be converted automatically. Custom shaders should consume the paint mask themselves. Surface filters are Godot physics collision layer masks. Particle overrides accept a PackedScene.

members.member: The 3D physics layers the pool raycast checks for surfaces that can receive blood.
Automatically converts standard materials on painted meshes to use the built-in blood shader. Custom shaders can read the chosen vertex color channel directly.
Legacy value retained for scene and script compatibility. The current paint animation uses a shader uniform.
Duration of the first blood paint reveal on the main body, in seconds. Detached limbs and other painted meshes reveal their paint immediately.
The custom pool material used when [member override_blood_decal] is enabled. Assigning one takes over the pool appearance from the built-in material.
The pool fade-out duration in seconds. The fade starts after one fifth of this time. Set to [code]0[/code] to keep the pool until it is removed.
The replacement image for the built-in pool effect. The texture alpha defines the pool's silhouette.
The size of one world-space noise tile, in meters, for the built-in fallback pool material. Larger values make the detail repeat less often.
Controls the hardness of the paint mask at the edge of a cut. Higher values give a fuller center and a sharper edge.
The radius of blood paint around the cut on the detached limb, in meters.
The radius of blood paint around the cut on the source body, in meters.
Legacy value retained for scene and script compatibility. Use the paint radii to adjust the size of new paint marks.
The scale of the blood burst. This affects the built-in particles and custom burst scenes.
Multiplier for the width and length of each spawned blood pool.
The vertex color channel used as the blood paint mask. Reserve that channel on painted meshes. The default is blue.
Spawns a blood burst automatically when a limb is cut. Manual effect calls are independent of this toggle.
Casts a ray from each cut and places a blood pool on a matching surface. Manual effect calls are independent of this toggle.
Paints blood around each cut on the source body and detached limb. Manual paint calls are independent of this toggle.
The custom blood burst scene. It needs a [Node3D] root and is instantiated at the cut point.
Uses [member blood_decal] as the pool material when one is assigned. The built-in material is used while the slot is empty.
Lets [member blood_decal_texture] replace the default blood pool image. This applies to the built-in pool material.
Uses [member fx_blood_burst] in place of the built-in particle effect. Assign a valid scene to spawn a burst.
Uses world coordinates for the built-in fallback material's noise and stretches the pool along the splatter direction. Turning this off uses local texture coordinates and a round footprint.
